text:
Amelia CSM: Theta reached out to onboard a 14B contract-summarizer (theta-legal-14b). Constraints: BYOK (AWS CloudHSM), US-WEST-2 residency, 90d audit logs, and an eval on their 5k contract corpus. Theyd like a pilot in ~3 weeks; this intersects renewal (Aug 2026).

Ravi Sec: Confirming BYOK CloudHSM. We need their cluster endpoint, SOC/ISO docs, network diagram, and key rotation cadence to scope compliance.

Zoe Safety: Safety bench scope: PII/PHI span recall, contract-clause hallucination scoring, and redaction robustness. Request 200 de-identified contracts + 50 high-risk Q&A samples; otherwise we'll synthesize. Label bench 'theta_contracts_v1'.

Jon ML: Model format? If PyTorch weights, we can stage. Ask customer for sample inference config (batch, max_tokens) and any finetune notes.

Amelia CSM: They provided: format=pt, batch=4, max_tokens=512. Traffic: peak ~30rps, avg ~8rps, p95 goal <350ms.

Priya Eng: Rollout plan (if prioritized): Day 0-3 security intake + HSM onboarding; Day 4-9 staging deploy + safety evals; Day 10-14 canary ramp; Day 15-21 pilot monitoring. Fallback to redwood-legal-7b on errors. Tight but doable if CloudHSM onboarding isn't blocked.

Ravi Sec: I'll open ticket for HSM intake and list artifact checklist.

OpsBot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-ONBOARD-8222  Theta CloudHSM + safety intake. https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-8222

Amelia CSM: Action items: Ravi collect security docs, Zoe draft eval checklist, Priya prep rollout, Jon prep staging infra. I'll request the de-id samples and schedule an enablement call. Marking account health as 'watch' until HSM cleared. :thumbsup:
